name: Two-estimator agreement side
rule: Frozen before the first bet. Any change to signal, threshold, universe or settlement is a NEW strategy with a NEW id and a new hash; the old record is never edited, so a reader can always tell whether the rule moved.
settlement_rule: side correct if the picked club's final score is higher. Push impossible: a moneyline has no line.
thesis: When two independent estimators agree on a side and the edge is not tiny, the pick is not an artefact of one model's scaling.
universe: every game in the results feed with ≥30 prior games (walk-forward)
